text: Implement owner-selected project policy with repository-owned reusable CI: generated documentation, scoped package/test/vignette lintr, R CMD check, pkgdown and coverage measurement remain mandatory alongside the OS matrix. rOpenSci action retains raw diagnostics and explicit summary as advisory; its master-branch naming and complexity rules are not project release gates. This replaces inherited INBO policy instead of falsely reporting full external-checker conformance. Scientific qualification protocols retain separate hash-bound execution checks.
